author: Seung Wook
problem: Given strings S and T, print Yes if there are integers c and w with 1 <= c <= w < |S| such that, when S is cut into pieces of w characters from the start, the c-th characters of the pieces that have at least c characters, read in order, spell T; otherwise print No.
bug_description: The last row is padded with len(s) % w spaces instead of w - len(s) % w, so it can stay shorter than w and zip drops the later columns.

comments.accurate: Tries every width w, cuts S into rows of w characters and checks whether any column reads T
comments.wrong_behavior: Cuts S into rows of each width w, pads the last row with len(S) % w spaces, and checks whether any column reads T
comments.wrong_location: Row padding verified; check the range of widths, which stops before len(S)
